# nxos_queuing_qos (Resource)

This resource can manage the queuing QoS configuration on NX-OS devices, including policy maps with class-based queuing priorities, bandwidth allocation, and system egress policy assignments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nxos_queuing_qos" "example" {
  policy_maps = {
    "PM1" = {
      match_type = "match-any"
      match_class_maps = {
        "c-out-q1" = {
          priority            = 3
          cap_average         = false
          drop_availability   = 7
          random_detect_ecn   = true
          max_threshold       = 3000
          max_threshold_unit  = "kbytes"
          min_threshold       = 150
          min_threshold_unit  = "kbytes"
          optimization        = "mesh"
          weight              = 5
          shape_max_rate      = 2000
          shape_max_rate_unit = "mbps"
          shape_min_rate      = 1000
          shape_min_rate_unit = "mbps"
          queue_limit_unit    = "kbytes"
          queue_limit         = 1000
          burst_detect_state  = "enabled"
        }
      }
    }
  }
  system_out_policy_map_name = "PM1"
  policy_map_statistics      = false
  policy_interface_out = {
    "eth1/10" = {
      policy_map_name       = "PM1"
      policy_map_statistics = false
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `policy_interface_out` (Attributes Map) List of interfaces with egress queuing policy assignments.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policy_interface_out))
- `policy_map_statistics` (Boolean) Turn on/off statistics.
- `policy_maps` (Attributes Map) List of policy maps.
  - Map key: `name` - Name of policy-map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policy_maps))
- `system_out_policy_map_name` (String) Policy-map Name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--policy_interface_out"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policy_interface_out`

Optional:

- `policy_map_name` (String) Policy-map Name.
- `policy_map_statistics` (Boolean) Turn on/off statistics.


<a id="nestedatt--policy_maps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policy_maps`

Optional:

- `match_class_maps` (Attributes Map) List of match class maps.
  - Map key: `name` - Match using class-map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policy_maps--match_class_maps))
- `match_type` (String) Match-any, match-all or match-first.
  - Choices: `match-any`, `match-all`, `match-first`

<a id="nestedatt--policy_maps--match_class_maps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policy_maps.match_class_maps`

Optional:

- `afd_ecn` (Boolean) Approximate Fair Discard ECN flag.
- `bandwidth` (Number) Available bandwidth.
  - Range: `0`-`100`
- `burst_detect_fall_threshold` (Number) Fall Threshold value for Micro burst detection.
  - Range: `0`-`13319072`
- `burst_detect_fall_threshold_unit` (String) Fall Threshold Unit for Micro burst detection.
  - Choices: `none`, `bytes`, `pct`
- `burst_detect_rise_threshold` (Number) Rise Threshold value for Micro burst detection.
  - Range: `0`-`13319072`
- `burst_detect_rise_threshold_unit` (String) Rise Threshold Unit for Micro burst detection.
  - Choices: `none`, `bytes`, `pct`
- `burst_detect_state` (String) Burst detect state enabled/disabled.
  - Choices: `disabled`, `enabled`
- `cap_average` (Boolean) cap average.
- `drop_availability` (Number) drop availability range.
  - Range: `0`-`100`
- `max_threshold` (Number) max threshold.
  - Range: `0`-`52428800`
- `max_threshold_unit` (String) max threshold.
  - Choices: `none`, `packets`, `bytes`, `kbytes`, `mbytes`
- `min_threshold` (Number) min threshold.
  - Range: `0`-`52428800`
- `min_threshold_unit` (String) min threshold.
  - Choices: `none`, `packets`, `bytes`, `kbytes`, `mbytes`
- `next_class_map` (String) Insert before the given class-map.
- `optimization` (String) random optimization type.
  - Choices: `burst`, `mesh`, `unknown`
- `previous_class_map` (String) Insert after the given class-map.
- `priority` (Number) Optional priority level.
  - Range: `1`-`8`
- `queue_desired` (Number) Approximate Fair Discard value.
  - Range: `1`-`52428800`
- `queue_desired_unit` (String) Units for Approximate Fair Discard value.
  - Choices: `none`, `bytes`, `kbytes`, `mbytes`
- `queue_limit` (Number) Value in bytes/kbytes/mbytes.
  - Range: `0`-`12582913`
- `queue_limit_dynamic` (Number) Queue-limit dynamic value.
  - Range: `0`-`255`
- `queue_limit_unit` (String) Bytes/kbytes/mbytes.
  - Choices: `none`, `packets`, `bytes`, `kbytes`, `mbytes`, `gbytes`, `ms`, `us`, `perc`
- `random_detect_ecn` (Boolean) ecn flag.
- `remaining_bandwidth` (Number) Remaining bandwidth.
  - Range: `0`-`100`
- `shape_max_rate` (Number) Maximum shape rate.
  - Range: `0`-`400000000000`
- `shape_max_rate_unit` (String) Maximum shape rate unit.
  - Choices: `unspecified`, `bps`, `kbps`, `mbps`, `gbps`, `pps`, `pct`
- `shape_min_rate` (Number) Minimum shape rate.
  - Range: `0`-`400000000000`
- `shape_min_rate_unit` (String) Minimum shape rate unit.
  - Choices: `unspecified`, `bps`, `kbps`, `mbps`, `gbps`, `pps`, `pct`
- `weight` (Number) weight range.
  - Range: `0`-`15`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = nxos_queuing_qos.example
  identity = {}
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema


#### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Terraform's `import` block requires a non-empty `id` value, so this format cannot be used to
# import nxos_queuing_qos for the default device. Use the `terraform import` command
# below, or identity-based import shown above, instead.
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nxos_queuing_qos.example ""
```
